title: nan
authors: Minervini A.; Carrio A.; Guglieri G.
key_contribution: Presents enhancements to a visual-inertial odometry algorithm (IMU motion prediction, multi-camera support, adaptive feature selection) to improve robustness and accuracy of drone pose estimation in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
